node.title: Inserting Code Before an -n/-p Loop
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Probably most people know about the "[https://metacpan.org/pod/distribution/perlsecret/lib/perlsecret.pod#Eskimo-greeting|Eskimo greeting]" "secret operator". I'm not sure if the following trick is common knowledge, but I just saw it for the first time in [http://blogs.perl.org/users/yary/2016/01/utf-16-and-windows-crlf-oh-my.html|this blog post by Yary]:

$ perl -MO=Deparse -M'5;print "foo"' -ne '}{print "bar"' sub BEGIN { require 5; () } print 'foo'; LINE: while (defined($_ = readline ARGV)) { (); } { print 'bar'; }

A neat little trick :-)
